product: Agilysys PMS plus InfoGenesis POS and an ecosystem of add-on modules (spa, golf, inventory Eatec, sales and catering) sold to hotels, casinos, cruise lines and foodservice, plus new AI-native CRS and Revenue Intelligence. 2026-07-27 (SEC 8-K): Q1 FY27 added 15 new customers averaging close to six products and 106 add-on deals covering 206 products.
demand: Volume and mix, not price. 2026-07-27 (SEC 8-K EX-99.1): 15 new customers, 87 new properties from existing parents, 106 add-on deals; subscription revenue up 26.1% y/y while one-time product revenue stayed flat near 10M per quarter and hardware attach keeps shrinking as modern POS runs on customer-bought iPads.
